Message:
drm/amdgpu: force pa_sc_tile_steering_override to 0 for navy_flounder

pa_sc_tile_steering_override is only programmable for
gfx10.0/10.1/10.2, and navy_flounder has the same gfx10.3 IP
with sienna_cichlid.
